log_level.description: The logging verbosity level (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL)

log_file.description: Path to the log file; empty string disables file logging

state_path.description: Directory path where the agent stores its runtime state (e.g., PID files, lock files)

bgp_router_id.description: The BGP router ID (must be a valid IPv4 address); typically the node's management IP

keepalive_interval.description: Time in seconds between BGP keepalive messages

hold_interval.description: BGP hold time in seconds (must be \u2265 keepalive_interval \u00d7 3)
